name: Nekto Core
author: wpnekto

sections.description:
Nekto Core enhances your WordPress site by adding a new custom post type called Projects, with associated categories, a shortcode to display them, a meta box for client info, and a widget to show the latest projects.

Translation ==\nThis plugin is translation ready. Use the .pot file in /languages.\n\n== Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/nekto-core.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [nekto_projects number="5"] in any post or page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with CPT, taxonomy, shortcode, widget and metabox.
